\documentclass{article}
\def\pair(#1,#2){[#1|#2]}
\def\upto#1.{<#1>}
\def\word#1 {(#1)}
\def\tail#1\stop{\textbf{#1}}
\def\mixed#1:#2{#1=#2}
\begin{document}
\pair(a,b) \pair({x,y},z)

\upto hello world. after

\word abc def

\tail some \emph{text}\stop done

\mixed key:{value} rest

\pair no match
\end{document}
